gen-dafont-quantum-gf-halant: Quantum draws its letters like smooth wire, loosely spaced and with short ascenders. But Halant counters with a towering x-height and a faint thick-thin shift, which gives the text a grounded, traditional authority.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-marcellus-sc: Smooth, loose and tech-clean: that is Quantum, every stroke of equal heft. Marcellus SC, a serif, then carries a long read with restrained thick-thin rhythm and tall, cast-iron lowercase.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-montagu-slab: Quantum opens things with loose, spacious letterfit and no thin hairline anywhere in its strokes. Montagu Slab, a text serif, adds slender turns of respectable weight; larger sizing helps the heading.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Quantum sets a smooth, drawn-wire heading with generous spacing and compact ascenders above a text serif, Noto Serif Hentaigana. Its small letters stand nearly capital-tall, with open jaws on curves.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-ovo: Spacious, tidy and unshaded, Quantum has a steady outline and short ascenders. Ovo, a serif, brings its own gifts: a soft thick-thin difference and a tall middle band.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-esteban: Esteban, a text serif, has thin parts barely slimmer than its stems and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Esteban's wide-open e then meets Redux, a geometric display face with big curved entrances.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-faustina: Big, visible entrances into every curve mark Redux, with wide spacing and an enlarged lowercase. Faustina, a classic serif, follows with bowls that thin gracefully and capitals only slightly taller than its lowercase.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-halant: Redux brings wide spacing and generous curved entrances to the heading, with a geometric, contemporary feel. But Halant, a classic serif, adds towering lowercase and outward-pointing terminals that make a longer page feel traditional.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Redux spaces its letters wide and enlarges the lowercase. Hedvig Letters Serif, a serif, adds open-ended curves, a tall sturdy body and medium contrast, giving the pair a grounded, authoritative feel.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-lisu-bosa: Redux enters every curve with a big, visible swoop and spaces its letters wide. Lisu Bosa, a classic serif, spills its counters into the surrounding space with tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy.
